G1 Jockey Wii.name: G1 Jockey Wii
G1 Jockey Wii.summary: As well as giving gamers the opportunity to whip themselves into shape while striving to be the king of the final furlong, G1 Jockey Wii also contains an incredibly deep career mode where players get the chance to work their way from rookie status to horse racing legend.

JumpStart Pet Rescue.name: Jumpstart Pet Rescue
JumpStart Pet Rescue.summary:
Join the JumpStart friends on a learning adventure designed for little hands and big imaginations!

The first learning game for preschoolers ever offered for Wii, JumpStart Pet Rescue is packed with over 80 fun-filled lessons and activities designed for 3-6 year olds. As players explore five worlds on a mission to rescue lost pets, they practice over 75 essential skills including pre-reading, memory, listening and more.

Spellbound Party.name: Spellbound Party
Spellbound Party.summary: Spellbound Party offers a fun learning experience for the whole family. Take on friends and family in the ultimate spelling showdown in a crazy game show environment. Your host will take you on a rollercoaster ride of fun as you go head to head with up to 3 players in 'Party' mode. To give learning a competitive edge players are rewarded more points for choosing difficult words to spell. Children can also take on adults in Spellbound Generations mode where the spelling level is determined by the players' age. Features: * Choose from 8 avatars as well as slots for guest players * 4 Single Player modes: Championships, Training, Mini-Games, List of Shame * Up to 4 players can battle it out in the multiplayer Party Mode * Spellbound Generations mode offers a handicapping system allowing kids to compete against adults
